Officer's narrative
On arrival at the scene in Conroe, Texas, I found two vehicles involved in a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1
remained seated in the vehicle and reported pain in the left wrist, stating that it struck the steering wehel during the
impact. The force of the collision appeared consistent with that type of injury. Driver 2 reported no injuries. A
Passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle and confirmed that Driver 1 was inside during the crash, and the witnesses at the
scene gave the same account.
On inspection, the dents on Driver 1's vehicle were on the side and at a height that did not match the frontal impact
described. A nearby camera showed no collision at that location during the time reported. No earlier damage to Driver
1's vehicle is known from available records. Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle. Further review of the
camera footage and the damage pattern is recommended before the account is accepted.
</page>
